  • One question at a time. The top bar shows the practice time; each question also shows the time you have spent on it.
  • Use Mark for Review to come back to a question. Colours in the palette show your status.

  • There is no score and nothing is sent anywhere. When you submit, you see a summary of how you used your time. Press Check answer on a question to see if you are right. If you are not, change your answer and check again, or press Show answer. Only the answer is shown, not the working.
